papers.title: The role of particle therapy in the treatment of locally recurrent rectal cancer: a systematic review
papers.authors: Perpar A, Georg P, Ermenc A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer is a common malignancy. Advancements in multimodality treatment have improved outcomes. About 2-10% of patients will have a local recurrence even after optimal treatment. Salvage surgical treatment is the treatment of choice, however, in posterior and lateral recurrences, surgery is linked to a high rate of treatment-related morbidity. Some recurrences remain unresectable even after neoadjuvant treatment.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A systematic literature review was performed to search for studies on curative-intent radiation therapy (RT) with photons, stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) and particle beam therapy. The aim of the literature search was to define the role of particle therapy in the treatment of patients with unresectable or inoperable local recurrences of rectal cancer where neoadjuvant treatment is unlikely to result in downstaging, leaving patients with RT as the only curative treatment option.
RESULTS: 32 studies which fulfil the criteria were identified. In general, SBRT and particle beam therapy permitted the application of significantly higher doses to the target without a concomitant increase in treatment-related toxicities.
CONCLUSIONS: For unresectable and inoperable locally recurrent rectal cancer ablative radiotherapy techniques such as SBRT and particle beam therapy offer a curative treatment approach as an alternative to surgery. SBRT can be offered for small local and nodal recurrences, while particle beam therapy can be offered for larger recurrences and complex shapes spanning several anatomical compartments as well. Further research is needed to stratify patients according to their need and eligibility for the different possible modalities of curative-intent RT.

papers.title_zh: 粒子治療在局部復發性直腸癌治療中的角色：一篇系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸直腸癌是常見的惡性腫瘤。多模式治療的進展已改善其預後。約2-10%的患者即使接受最佳治療後仍會發生局部復發。搶救性手術是首選治療方式，然而對於後側及側方復發，手術與高治療相關併發症率相關。部分復發病灶即使經過新輔助治療後仍無法切除。

方法：進行系統性文獻回顧，搜尋以光子放射治療（RT）、立體定位身體放射治療（SBRT）及粒子束治療進行根治性放射治療的研究。文獻搜尋之目的為界定粒子治療在治療無法切除或無法手術之直腸癌局部復發患者中的角色，此類患者新輔助治療不太可能達到降期效果，使放射治療成為唯一的根治性治療選擇。

結果：共identified出32篇符合條件的研究。整體而言，SBRT與粒子束治療能在不伴隨治療相關毒性增加的情況下，對目標病灶施加顯著較高的劑量。

結論：對於無法切除及無法手術之局部復發直腸癌，如SBRT與粒子束治療等消融性放射治療技術，提供了手術之外的根治性治療替代方案。SBRT可用於較小的局部及淋巴結復發，而粒子束治療則可用於較大、形狀複雜且跨越多個解剖腔室的復發病灶。仍需進一步研究以根據患者需求及各種根治性放射治療模式之適用性進行分層。
papers.score_reason: 僅為敘述性系統回顧、無統合分析與定量合併數據，但對台灣少數無法手術之復發直腸癌病人轉介放腫時具參考價值。

papers.title: Evidence Gap in Managing Lateral Pelvic Lymph Nodes in Rectal Cancer: a Systematic Review of Radiation Boost Strategies
papers.authors: Pinar S, Wong T, Mitchell T, Kong C
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Lateral pelvic lymph node (LPLN) involvement is a significant predictor of local recurrence in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC). While lateral pelvic lymph node dissection (LPLND) is routinely used in some countries to manage suspicious nodes, it is associated with increased morbidity and is not widely adopted in Western practice. Radiation boost (dose escalation) to involved LPLNs during neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) has emerged as a potential non-surgical alternative. Despite increasing adoption of radiation boost to clinically involved LPLNs, there remains limited evidence defining its safety, oncologic benefit, and role relative to LPLND.
METHODS: A systematic search of MEDLINE, EMBASE, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Cochrane databases was conducted following PRISMA guidelines. Studies were included if they reported outcomes of radiation dose escalation specifically targeting radiologically suspicious LPLNs in the context of nCRT.
RESULTS: Ten retrospective cohort studies encompassing 482 radiation boosted patients were included. Boost doses ranged from 35.0 to 60.2 Gy. Rates of Grade 2-3 toxicity ranged from 28.0% to 39.3% across individual studies, with only one study reporting a single Grade 4 adverse event. Across individual studies, reported nodal response rates ranged from 62.3% to 100%. Comparative studies suggest that radiation boost may improve local control and reduce LPLN recurrence.
CONCLUSION: Current retrospective evidence suggests that radiation dose escalation to involved LPLNs is a promising treatment strategy; however, the available data are limited by retrospective study designs and substantial clinical heterogeneity. Given the absence of prospective evidence and lack of consensus in current guidelines, an important evidence gap remains. Well-designed prospective trials are warranted to define the role of LPLN boost relative to LPLND.
papers.title_zh: 直腸癌側骨盆淋巴結處理之證據缺口：放射線劇量加強策略的系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：側骨盆淋巴結（LPLN）侵犯是局部進行性直腸癌（LARC）患者局部復發的重要預測因子。雖然側骨盆淋巴結廓清術（LPLND）在某些國家已常規用於處理疑似淋巴結，但其與較高的併發症相關，且未廣泛被西方臨床採用。在新輔助放化療（nCRT）期間對受侵犯的LPLN進行放射線劇量加強（劇量提升）已成為一種潛在的非手術替代方案。儘管對臨床上受侵犯的LPLN採用放射線劇量加強的作法日益增加，但關於其安全性、腫瘤學益處，以及相對於LPLND的角色，證據仍然有限。方法：依照PRISMA指引，針對MEDLINE、EMBASE、ClinicalTrials.gov及Cochrane資料庫進行系統性文獻搜尋。納入報告針對放射學上疑似LPLN於nCRT情境下進行劇量提升結果的研究。結果：共納入10篇回溯性世代研究，總計482名接受放射線劇量加強的患者。劇量加強範圍為35.0至60.2 Gy。各研究間第2-3級毒性發生率為28.0%至39.3%，僅一篇研究報告單一第4級不良事件。各研究間報告的淋巴結反應率為62.3%至100%。比較性研究顯示放射線劇量加強可能改善局部控制並降低LPLN復發。結論：目前的回溯性證據顯示，對受侵犯LPLN進行放射線劇量提升是一項具潛力的治療策略；然而現有資料受限於回溯性研究設計及顯著的臨床異質性。由於缺乏前瞻性證據且目前指引缺乏共識，重要的證據缺口仍然存在。需要設計良好的前瞻性試驗以確立LPLN劇量加強相對於LPLND的角色。

papers.title: Staying minimally invasive: robotic versus laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery in a propensity-weighted Italian multicentre cohort
papers.authors: Giordano A, Marano L, Lamacchia G, Andreuccetti J, Brillantino A, Farina M
papers.abstract: To compare conversion to open surgery after intended robotic versus laparoscopic colorectal cancer resection in routine multicentre practice. This secondary post hoc analysis of the retrospective ATOCCS cohort included elective, curative-intent resections performed during 2022-2024 at Italian centres using both approaches. Propensity-score overlap weighting with centre indicators and multiple imputation addressed measured confounding and missing covariates. Centre-clustered models estimated adjusted risks, risk differences, and risk ratios. The primary cohort comprised 2,284 patients at 23 centres (1,408 laparoscopic; 876 robotic); conversion was evaluable in 2,278. Conversion occurred in 108/1,403 (7.7%) laparoscopic and 16/875 (1.8%) robotic procedures. Adjusted risks were 9.2% and 2.2%, respectively (risk difference, - 7.0 percentage points; 95% CI, - 11.1 to - 2.8; risk ratio, 0.24; 95% CI, 0.09-0.65; P=0.001). Within-centre propensity-score matching produced a similar risk difference (- 7.6 percentage points; 95% CI, - 11.3 to - 4.0). Major morbidity and reoperation did not differ detectably. Robotic surgery was associated with 42.8 min longer adjusted operative time (95% CI, 18.5-67.0), while the length-of-stay ratio was 0.91 (95% CI, 0.82-1.01). In dual-approach centres, intended robotic surgery was associated with fewer conversions but longer operations and no demonstrated improvement in the principal postoperative outcomes. Residual confounding precludes causal or superiority claims. Trial registration: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07718919.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的為比較常規多中心臨床實務中，計劃性機器人輔助與腹腔鏡大腸直腸癌切除術後轉開腹之情形。本研究為ATOCCS回溯性佇列的次要事後分析，納入2022-2024年間義大利各中心以兩種術式進行的擇期、根治性切除病例。以中心指標進行傾向分數重疊加權（overlap weighting）並搭配多重插補，處理已測量之干擾因子與遺漏共變項。中心叢集模型（centre-clustered models）估計調整後風險、風險差與風險比。主要佇列共2,284名病人，來自23個中心（腹腔鏡1,408人；機器人876人）；轉開腹可評估者2,278人。轉開腹發生於腹腔鏡108/1,403例（7.7%）及機器人16/875例（1.8%）。調整後風險分別為9.2%與2.2%（風險差-7.0個百分點；95% CI，-11.1至-2.8；風險比0.24；95% CI，0.09-0.65；P=0.001）。中心內傾向分數配對得到相似的風險差（-7.6個百分點；95% CI，-11.3至-4.0）。重大併發症與再手術率未偵測到顯著差異。機器人手術與調整後手術時間延長42.8分鐘相關（95% CI，18.5-67.0），住院天數比值為0.91（95% CI，0.82-1.01）。在兩種術式並存的中心中，計劃性機器人手術與較少轉開腹相關，但手術時間較長，且主要術後結果並無明顯改善。殘留干擾因子使本研究無法宣稱因果關係或優越性。試驗註冊：ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07718919。

papers.title: Long-Term Mortality in Diabetic Foot Disease is Higher Than That of Overall Cancer: Results From Three International Cohorts
papers.authors: Zeng Q, Tang Z, Chen X, Zhan L, Balasubramanian V, Chen Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Guidelines suggest that the risk of mortality in diabetic foot disease (DFD) is comparable to that of cancer; however, high-quality evidence is lacking. We aimed to compare the mortality of DFD with that of various cancers based on data from international cohorts.
METHODS: We defined DFD according to the IWGDF 2023 guidelines, and cancer was defined based on the ICD-10 codes. We included 527, 1784, and 601 patients with DFD and 1219, 100,643, and 152 patients with cancer from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), UK Biobank (UKB), and Chongqing Diabetes Registration (CDR) cohorts, respectively. We compared the risk of mortality between DFD and overall or site-specific cancers in the same cohort.
RESULTS: Patients with DFD showed 38%, 45%, and 499% higher risks of mortality than patients with overall cancer in the NHANES, UKB, and CDR. For site-specific cancer, the risk of mortality was significantly higher in DFD than in skin cancer (hazard ratio 10.69, 95% CI: 1.37-2.07 in NHANSE; 3.8, 3.72-448 in UKB), breast cancer (1.35, 1.0-1.83 in NHANSE; 1.95, 1.67-227 in UKB), and prostate cancer (1.4, 1.8-179 in NHANSE; 2.61, 2.35-289 in UKB). The mortality rate of DFD is similar to that of most types of cancer, such as colon cancer, lymphoma, and kidney cancer, and is lower than that of a minority of cancers, including lung, pancreatic, and liver cancers.
CONCLUSION: Patients with DFD have a higher risk of mortality than overall cancer, particularly skin, breast, and prostate cancers.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：指引建議糖尿病足病（DFD）的死亡風險與癌症相當；然而，目前缺乏高品質證據。我們旨在根據國際世代研究資料，比較DFD與各種癌症的死亡率。方法：我們依據IWGDF 2023指引定義DFD，並依據ICD-10代碼定義癌症。我們納入了來自NHANES、UK Biobank（UKB）及重慶糖尿病登記（CDR）世代分別527、1784、601名DFD患者，以及1219、100643、152名癌症患者。我們在同一世代中比較DFD與整體或特定部位癌症之間的死亡風險。結果：DFD患者在NHANES、UKB及CDR中，死亡風險分別比整體癌症患者高38%、45%、499%。就特定部位癌症而言，DFD的死亡風險顯著高於皮膚癌（風險比10.69，95% CI：1.37-2.07於NHANES；3.8，3.72-448於UKB）、乳癌（1.35，1.0-1.83於NHANES；1.95，1.67-227於UKB）及前列腺癌（1.4，1.8-179於NHANES；2.61，2.35-289於UKB）。DFD的死亡率與多數癌症類型相似，如大腸癌、淋巴瘤及腎癌，並低於少數癌症，包括肺癌、胰臟癌及肝癌。結論：DFD患者的死亡風險高於整體癌症，特別是皮膚癌、乳癌及前列腺癌。

papers.title: Mesalazine enteric-coated tablets combined with retention enema for symptom alleviation in mild to moderate E2-type active ulcerative colitis: A retrospective comparative cohort study
papers.authors: Zhang R, Wang S, Yang M, Yang C, Yang D, Zhao Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease impacting quality of life. Combination oral and topical mesalazine is guideline-recommended for left-sided UC, but real-world data remain limited.
OBJECTIVES: This retrospective study evaluated the efficacy and safety of mesalazine enteric-coated tablets plus a retention enema in patients with mild-to-moderate E2-type (left-sided) active UC.
METHODS: Patients with mild to moderate E2-type active UC treated at a single center from January 2021 to December 2022 were retrospectively screened. After applying inclusion and exclusion criteria, 88 patients were included and assigned to either the study group (mesalazine enteric-coated tablets 1.0 g four times daily plus mesalazine retention enema 4.0 g once daily) or the control group (oral mesalazine enteric-coated tablets 1.0 g four times daily alone) based on clinical availability and patient preference. Treatment duration was 30 days. Outcomes included clinical efficacy (using modified local criteria and Mayo score components), symptom relief and time to improvement, endoscopic findings (Mayo Endoscopic Subscore), and adverse events.
RESULTS: The "effective" rate was significantly higher in the study group (77.27% vs. 34.09%; OR=6.58, P<0.001). Symptom relief rate was 97.73% vs. 72.73% (OR=13.44, P=0.002). Symptom improvement times were shorter in the study group (all P<0.05). Post-treatment Mayo Endoscopic Subscore was lower in the study group (1.14±0.41 vs. 2.05±0.65; mean difference -0.91, P<0.001). Ulcer and congestion/edema incidences were lower in the study group (6.82% and 18.18% vs. 25.00% and 47.73%). Adverse events were mild and comparable between groups (13.64% vs. 11.36%, P=0.746).
CONCLUSION: Mesalazine enteric-coated tablets combined with retention enema demonstrated superior efficacy compared to oral monotherapy for short-term symptom relief and mucosal healing in patients with mild to moderate E2-type active UC, with a favorable safety profile. Larger prospective studies with longer follow-up are needed to confirm these findings and evaluate long-term outcomes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）為影響生活品質之慢性發炎性腸道疾病。指引建議左側UC使用口服併局部美沙拉腦治療，但真實世界資料仍有限。目的：本回溯性研究評估美沙拉腦腸溶片併用保留灌腸於輕至中度E2型（左側）活動性UC病人之療效與安全性。方法：回溯篩選2021年1月至2022年12月於單一中心接受治療之輕至中度E2型活動性UC病人。經納入排除條件後，共納入88名病人，依臨床可得性與病人偏好分配至研究組（美沙拉腦腸溶片1.0g每日四次併美沙拉腦保留灌腸4.0g每日一次）或對照組（單獨口服美沙拉腦腸溶片1.0g每日四次）。治療期間為30天。結果指標包括臨床療效（採用修改後局部標準及Mayo評分組分）、症狀緩解及改善時間、內視鏡發現（Mayo內視鏡子分數）及不良事件。結果：研究組「有效」率顯著較高（77.27% vs. 34.09%；OR=6.58，P<0.001）。症狀緩解率為97.73% vs. 72.73%（OR=13.44，P=0.002）。研究組症狀改善時間較短（所有P<0.05）。治療後Mayo內視鏡子分數研究組較低（1.14±0.41 vs. 2.05±0.65；平均差-0.91，P<0.001）。潰瘍及充血/水腫發生率研究組較低（6.82%及18.18% vs. 25.00%及47.73%）。不良事件輕微且兩組相當（13.64% vs. 11.36%，P=0.746）。結論：美沙拉腦腸溶片併用保留灌腸在輕至中度E2型活動性UC病人之短期症狀緩解及黏膜癒合方面優於口服單一療法，安全性良好。需要更大型前瞻性研究及更長追蹤期以確認此結果並評估長期預後。

papers.title: The aspiration of precision glucocorticoid pharmacotherapy in immune-mediated diseases: where do we stand in integrating pharmacogenomics and biomarkers for individualized treatment?
papers.abstract: Glucocorticoids remain among the most widely prescribed immunosuppressive and anti-inflammatory agents worldwide, yet their clinical use is complicated by substantial inter-individual variability in both therapeutic response and adverse effects. Despite decades of clinical experience, glucocorticoid prescribing remains largely empirical, with limited integration of precision medicine approaches that could optimize therapeutic outcomes while minimizing toxicity. This review synthesizes current evidence on emerging precision approaches to glucocorticoid therapy across three key domains: pharmacogenomic determinants (including variants in NR3C1, FKBP5, CYP3A4/5, and ABCB1) that modulate immune cell responsiveness to glucocorticoids; pharmacokinetic variability and model-informed precision dosing strategies; and disease-specific biomarker-guided approaches across major immune-mediated conditions including respiratory diseases, rheumatologic conditions, inflammatory bowel disease, polymyalgia rheumatica, and critical illness. Genetic variants in glucocorticoid receptor signaling and drug metabolism pathways have suggested some associations with treatment response and adverse effects, although none are yet acknowledged as clinically actionable by consensus resources. Disease-specific immunological biomarkers including eosinophil counts, inflammatory cytokines, and pharmacodynamic endpoints suggest the promise of individualized dose optimization. Risk stratification for glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis-mediated through OPG/RANKL signaling and monocyte-osteoclast crosstalk-incorporating both clinical factors and pharmacogenetic markers may facilitate targeted prevention strategies. The integration of pharmacogenomic testing, immune biomarker monitoring, and pharmacokinetic modeling represents an aspirational paradigm shift from empirical dosing to individualized immunomodulatory therapy. It should be acknowledged that, as of the time of writing, this precision framework remains largely investigational: routine clinical practice continues to rely predominantly on indication-specific regimens and empirical tapering protocols. This review is explicitly forward-looking, aiming to outline a research agenda for precision glucocorticoid therapy in immune-mediated diseases.
papers.title_zh: 免疫介導疾病中精準糖皮質素藥物治療的展望：藥物基因體學與生物標記在個人化治療整合上的現況
papers.abstract_zh: 糖皮質素仍是全球最廣泛使用的免疫抑制劑與抗發炎藥物之一，然而其臨床使用因治療反應與不良反應存在顯著個體間差異而變得複雜。儘管已有數十年的臨床經驗，糖皮質素的處方仍大多依賴經驗性判斷，精準醫療方法的整合有限，而這些方法本可優化治療結果並減少毒性。本綜述整合了目前關於糖皮質素治療精準方法的證據，涵蓋三大領域：藥物基因體學決定因子（包括NR3C1、FKBP5、CYP3A4/5、ABCB1的變異）調節免疫細胞對糖皮質素的反應性；藥物動力學變異性與模型導引之精準劑量策略；以及跨主要免疫介導疾病（包括呼吸道疾病、風濕性疾病、發炎性腸道疾病、風濕性多發性肌痛及重症疾病）的疾病特異性生物標記導引方法。糖皮質素受體訊號傳遞與藥物代謝路徑中的基因變異已顯示與治療反應及不良反應有一定關聯，但目前尚無任何變異被共識性資源認定為具臨床可行動性。疾病特異性免疫學生物標記，包括嗜伊紅性白血球計數、發炎性細胞激素及藥效學終點，顯示個人化劑量優化的潛力。透過OPG/RANKL訊號傳遞及單核球-破骨細胞相互作用進行糖皮質素誘發骨質疏鬆症的風險分層，結合臨床因子與藥物基因體標記，可能有助於制定針對性的預防策略。整合藥物基因體檢測、免疫生物標記監測及藥物動力學模型，代表從經驗性劑量轉向個人化免疫調節治療的理想典範轉移。應當承認，截至撰稿時，此精準框架仍大多屬於研究性質：常規臨床實務仍主要依賴適應症特異性療程與經驗性減量方案。本綜述明確地面向未來，旨在為免疫介導疾病之精準糖皮質素治療勾勒研究議程。

papers.title: Computational identification and experimental validation of shared diagnostic biomarkers and gene signatures across HLA-B27-associated immune-mediated diseases
papers.ptype: Validation Study, Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
papers.authors: Zhu X, Liang C, Xu Z, Zhao X, Shi L, He J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: HLA-B27 is strongly associated with a spectrum of immune-mediated diseases, including axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA), psoriatic arthritis (PsA), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and acute anterior uveitis (AAU). However, the shared molecular mechanisms and cross-disease diagnostic biomarkers remain poorly defined. This study aimed to identify common gene signatures and potential diagnostic biomarkers across HLA-B27-related diseases using bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation.
METHODS: Gene expression datasets for axSpA, PsA, ulcerative colitis (UC), Crohn's disease (CD), and AAU were retrieved from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Disease-specific diagnostic genes were identified via differential expression analysis, least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis (AUC > 0.9). Shared biomarkers were determined by intersecting differentially expressed genes (DEGs) across all five diseases. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks, functional enrichment analyses, and single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA) were performed to explore biological pathways and immune infiltration patterns. Competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA)-transcription factor (TF) regulatory networks were constructed, and potential therapeutic agents were predicted using the Drug-Gene Interaction Database (DGIdb). Finally, the expression of candidate genes was validated by RT-qPCR and Western blot in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from patients with ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and UC.
RESULTS: A total of 2485, 380, 2682, 2232, and 481 DEGs were identified for axSpA, PsA, UC, CD, and AAU, respectively, with ABCD2 being the only shared biomarker across all five diseases. Disease-specific diagnostic gene panels were established (3 genes for axSpA, 6 for PsA, 15 for UC, 9 for CD, and 4 for AAU). Two major gene clusters were uncovered: an arthritis-related cluster (LAG3, IL15, PRF1, TBX21, IL2RB) and an extra-articular disease-related cluster (IL6, FN1, F2R, HIF1A, ANGPT2). Immune infiltration profiles varied significantly across diseases. Regulatory network analysis revealed complex ceRNA-TF interactions and identified several candidate drugs. In PBMCs, ABCD2 was upregulated in AS and UC, PRF1 in AS, and FN1, IL-6, and F2R in UC.
CONCLUSION: This study identifies ABCD2 as a potential cross-disease biomarker and two context-dependent key gene clusters for HLA-B27-associated immune-mediated diseases, providing exploratory candidates for future research.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：HLA-B27與一系列免疫相關疾病密切相關，包括中軸型脊椎關節炎（axSpA）、乾癬性關節炎（PsA）、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）及急性前葡萄膜炎（AAU）。然而，這些疾病間共同的分子機制與跨疾病診斷生物標記仍不明確。本研究旨在利用生物資訊學分析與實驗驗證，鑑定HLA-B27相關疾病間共同的基因特徵與潛在診斷生物標記。

方法：從Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）資料庫取得axSpA、PsA、潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）、克隆氏症（CD）及AAU之基因表現資料集。透過差異表現分析、LASSO回歸及ROC曲線分析（AUC > 0.9）鑑定各疾病特異性診斷基因。以五種疾病之差異表現基因（DEGs）取交集，確定共同生物標記。進行蛋白質-蛋白質交互作用（PPI）網路、功能富集分析及單樣本基因集富集分析（ssGSEA），以探討生物路徑與免疫浸潤模式。並構建ceRNA-轉錄因子（TF）調控網路，並利用Drug-Gene Interaction Database（DGIdb）預測潛在治療藥物。最後，於僵直性脊椎炎（AS）與UC患者之周邊血單核細胞（PBMCs）中，以RT-qPCR及西方墨點法驗證候選基因表現。

結果：axSpA、PsA、UC、CD及AAU分別鑑定出2485、380、2682、2232及481個DEGs，其中ABCD2為五種疾病共同之唯一生物標記。建立疾病特異性診斷基因套組（axSpA 3個基因、PsA 6個、UC 15個、CD 9個、AAU 4個）。發現兩大基因群集：關節炎相關群集（LAG3、IL15、PRF1、TBX21、IL2RB）及關節外疾病相關群集（IL6、FN1、F2R、HIF1A、ANGPT2）。各疾病間免疫浸潤特徵有顯著差異。調控網路分析顯示複雜的ceRNA-TF交互作用，並鑑定出多個候選藥物。在PBMCs中，ABCD2在AS及UC中上調，PRF1在AS中上調，FN1、IL-6及F2R在UC中上調。

結論：本研究鑑定出ABCD2為HLA-B27相關免疫疾病之潛在跨疾病生物標記，以及兩個情境依賴性關鍵基因群集，為未來研究提供探索性候選標記。

papers.title: Preoperative Predictors of Anastomotic Leak Following Digestive Cancer Surgery: A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.authors: Ghirlea O, Olariu S, Murariu M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anastomotic leak remains one of the most severe complications in digestive oncologic surgery, significantly impacting postoperative morbidity and mortality.
METHODS: A retrospective observational study was conducted. We collected and analyzed the data for 394 patients with digestive cancer, of which 248 received resection with primary anastomosis. The following variables were analyzed: tumor origin distribution, body mass index (BMI), gender, age, smoking status, tumor stage, American Society of Anesthesiologists score (ASA), hemoglobin levels and surgical indication (elective or emergency).
RESULTS: Anastomotic leakage occurred in 38,4% of cases. Univariate analysis showed significant associations with ASA >= 3, advanced tumor stage, emergency surgery, smoking, underweight BMI, and anemia severity (risk increased in a severity-dependent manner). Multivariate analysis identified ASA >= 3 (OR 9.60; p<0.001), mild anemia (OR 3.11; p=0.005), moderate/severe anemia (OR 7.63; p<0.001), and advanced tumor stage (OR 2.43; p=0.018) as independent predictors.
CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative physiological status and anemia severity are independently associated with anastomotic leak following digestive cancer surgery. The graded effect of anemia suggests a potentially modifiable risk factor amenable to preoperative optimization. Advanced malignancy (stages III and IV) plays an independent role in anastomotic leakage incidence.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：吻合口滲漏仍是消化道腫瘤手術中最嚴重的併發症之一，顯著影響術後併發症發生率與死亡率。方法：本研究為回溯性觀察性研究。收集並分析394名消化道癌症病人的資料，其中248人接受切除合併原位吻合手術。分析變項包括：腫瘤原發部位分布、身體質量指數(BMI)、性別、年齡、吸菸狀態、腫瘤期別、美國麻醉醫學會分數(ASA)、血紅素水平及手術適應症（選擇性或急診）。結果：吻合口滲漏發生率為38.4%。單變項分析顯示，ASA≥3、晚期腫瘤期別、急診手術、吸菸、體重過輕(BMI過低)及貧血嚴重度（風險隨嚴重度呈遞增關係）皆與吻合口滲漏有顯著相關。多變項分析確認ASA≥3（OR 9.60；p<0.001）、輕度貧血（OR 3.11；p=0.005）、中重度貧血（OR 7.63；p<0.001），以及晚期腫瘤期別（OR 2.43；p=0.018）為獨立預測因子。結論：術前生理狀態與貧血嚴重度與消化道癌症手術後吻合口滲漏獨立相關。貧血的分級效應提示這是一個可透過術前優化改善的潛在可矯正危險因子。晚期惡性腫瘤（第三期與第四期）在吻合口滲漏發生中扮演獨立角色。

papers.title: Association Between Bowel Urgency and Intestinal Ultrasound Parameters in Ulcerative Colitis: Insights Into Transmural Inflammation and Symptom Pathophysiology
papers.authors: Serizawa K, Sagami S, Umeda S, Asonuma K, Komatsu M, Shibui S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Bowel urgency (BU) is a key symptom of ulcerative colitis (UC), often impairing the quality of life. This study aimed to identify intestinal ultrasound parameters associated with BU, given that UC may also have transmural involvement, and compare these with endoscopic activity and biomarkers.
METHODS: In this single-centre prospective study, UC patients undergoing colonoscopy between January 31 and September 27, 2023 were enrolled. Transabdominal and transperineal ultrasound were performed to evaluate bowel wall thickness (BWT), including individual layers (mucosa, submucosa, and muscularis propria), and colour Doppler signal (CDS) in the sigmoid colon and rectum. BU was defined according to the Simple Clinical Colitis Activity Index urgency subscore.
RESULTS: Of 59 patients, 33 (56%) reported BU. Compared with those without BU, patients with BU had significantly higher C-reactive protein, Mayo Endoscopic Subscore (MES), BWT (descending colon, sigmoid colon, rectum), CDS (sigmoid colon, rectum), and submucosal and muscularis propria thickness in the sigmoid colon (all p < 0.05). Mucosal thickness and faecal calprotectin were not significantly different (p = 0.11 and p = 0.48, respectively). In MES-adjusted logistic regression, submucosal (p < 0.01) and muscularis propria (p = 0.03) thickness remained associated with BU, whereas mucosal thickness did not (p = 0.97). Receiver operating characteristic analysis showed that sigmoid submucosal thickness had greater diagnostic accuracy than mucosal thickness (AUC 0.77 vs. 0.62, p < 0.05).
CONCLUSIONS: Sigmoid submucosal thickening was associated with BU and suggests that transmural inflammation may contribute to symptom pathophysiology.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: UMIN000050099.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：排便急迫感（BU）是潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）的關鍵症狀，常影響生活品質。本研究旨在鑑定與BU相關的腸道超音波參數，並比較這些參數與內視鏡活動度及生物標記之關係，因UC亦可能有透壁性侵犯。方法：本單中心前瞻性研究納入2023年1月31日至9月27日間接受大腸鏡檢查之UC患者。以經腹及經會陰超音波評估腸壁厚度（BWT），包括各分層（黏膜、黏膜下層、肌肉層），以及乙狀結腸與直腸之彩色多普勒訊號（CDS）。BU依據Simple Clinical Colitis Activity Index急迫感次量表定義。結果：59名患者中，33名（56%）報告有BU。與無BU者相比，有BU患者之C反應蛋白、Mayo內視鏡評分（MES）、BWT（降結腸、乙狀結腸、直腸）、CDS（乙狀結腸、直腸）及乙狀結腸黏膜下層與肌肉層厚度皆顯著較高（皆p<0.05）。黏膜厚度與糞便鈣蛋白則無顯著差異（分別p=0.11、p=0.48）。經MES校正之邏輯回歸分析顯示，黏膜下層厚度（p<0.01）及肌肉層厚度（p=0.03）仍與BU相關，而黏膜厚度則無相關（p=0.97）。ROC分析顯示乙狀結腸黏膜下層厚度之診斷準確度優於黏膜厚度（AUC 0.77 vs. 0.62，p<0.05）。結論：乙狀結腸黏膜下層增厚與BU相關，提示透壁性發炎可能參與症狀病理機轉。試驗註冊：UMIN000050099。

papers.title: Chlorogenic Acid in Antitumor Therapy: Multi-Pathway Mechanisms, Nanocarrier-Mediated Smart Delivery, and Synergistic Combinatorial Strategies
papers.authors: Duan H, He J, Wang R, Wu J, Ding H
papers.abstract: Malignant tumors remain a global public health challenge with high morbidity and mortality. Conventional therapies are limited by severe adverse effects and drug resistance. Chlorogenic acid (CGA), a widely distributed phenolic compound, has emerged as a promising antitumor agent due to its excellent biocompatibility and multi-targeted bioactivities, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and pro-apoptotic. This review systematically summarizes the molecular mechanisms underlying the antitumor activity of CGA, focusing on three core aspects: (1) regulation of key signaling pathways (Janus kinase-signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK-STAT), Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase (MAPK), Nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-κB)) in tumor cells; (2) enhancement of host antitumor immune function through immune‑cell activation and cytokine‑network modulation; and (3) induction of tumor cell apoptosis via B-cell lymphoma 2 (Bcl-2) family regulation, oxidative stress, and metabolite synergy. Furthermore, we highlight recent advances in nanocarrier-facilitated delivery of CGA, including metal-based nanocomposites, metal oxide nanoparticles, and functionalized liposomes, and establish a horizontal comparison table to analyze their respective delivery efficiency, tumor accumulation, biosafety and immune activation capacity, which effectively overcome its pharmacokinetic shortcomings, such as short circulation half‑life and poor tumor accumulation. Additionally, synergistic antitumor effects achieved by combining CGA with chemotherapy drugs or immune checkpoint inhibitors across melanoma, lung cancer, colon cancer and hepatocellular carcinoma models are comprehensively discussed. This review provides a comprehensive theoretical foundation for the further development of CGA as a promising antitumor agent and its clinical translation, and outlining operable key challenges and future research directions.

papers.title_zh: 綠原酸於抗腫瘤治療之應用：多路徑機制、奈米載體智慧遞送與協同聯合策略
papers.abstract_zh: 惡性腫瘤因其高罹病率與死亡率，仍是全球公共衛生的一大挑戰。傳統療法受限於嚴重副作用與抗藥性。綠原酸（CGA）是一種廣泛分布的酚類化合物，因其優異的生物相容性與多靶點生物活性（包括抗氧化、抗炎、免疫調節與促凋亡作用），已成為具潛力的抗腫瘤藥物。本綜述系統性總結CGA抗腫瘤活性的分子機制，聚焦三大核心面向：(1) 調控腫瘤細胞內關鍵訊號路徑（JAK-STAT、MAPK、NF-κB）；(2) 透過免疫細胞活化與細胞因子網絡調節增強宿主抗腫瘤免疫功能；(3) 經由Bcl-2家族調控、氧化壓力與代謝物協同作用誘導腫瘤細胞凋亡。此外，本文亦重點介紹奈米載體輔助CGA遞送的最新進展，包括金屬基奈米複合物、金屬氧化物奈米粒子及功能化脂質體，並建立橫向比較表分析其遞送效率、腫瘤蓄積、生物安全性與免疫活化能力，以有效克服CGA藥物動力學上的缺陷，如循環半衰期短與腫瘤蓄積不佳。另外，本文全面討論CGA與化療藥物或免疫檢查點抑制劑併用在黑色素瘤、肺癌、大腸癌與肝細胞癌模型中所達成的協同抗腫瘤效果。本綜述為CGA作為潛力抗腫瘤藥物的進一步開發及臨床轉譯提供了全面的理論基礎，並闡明可操作的關鍵挑戰與未來研究方向。

papers.title: An Insight into the Emerging Role of Extracellular Vesicle-derived Noncoding RNAs in Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Jayaraman V, Apthi S, Datta L, Palaniyandi K, Gnanasampanthapandian D
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) ranks among the most frequent and lethal cancers globally, with early detection remaining a significant challenge because of asymptomatic early stages and limitations of current screening methods. This underscores the pressing need for new, non-invasive biomarkers for early CRC detection to enhance patient outcomes. Advancements in the molecular biology of cancer have highlighted the importance of non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) in the genesis and progression of CRC. Exosomal non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs), microRNAs (miRNAs), circular RNAs (circRNAs), and long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) have shown promise in this regard. These molecules, carried by small extracellular vesicles known as exosomes, are key players in cell communication and have been associated with the regulation of essential cancer pathways, including cell proliferation, metastasis, and drug resistance. This review discusses the potential of exosomal ncRNAs as innovative biomarkers and therapeutic targets in CRC. This study covers their role in cancer biology, the challenges in their application, and future directions for leveraging these ncRNAs to advance CRC diagnosis and treatment. Exploring exosomal ncRNAs opens new avenues for enhancing CRC management through early detection and targeted therapy, potentially transforming oncology patient care.

papers.title_zh: 深入探討細胞外囊泡衍生非編碼RNA在大腸直腸癌中新興角色之洞見
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是全球最常見且致死率最高的癌症之一，由於早期無症狀且現行篩檢方法有其限制，早期偵測仍是一大挑戰。這凸顯了開發新型、非侵入性生物標記以協助CRC早期偵測、改善病人預後的迫切需求。癌症分子生物學的進展已凸顯非編碼RNA（ncRNA）在CRC發生與進展中的重要性。外泌體非編碼RNA（ncRNA）、微小RNA（miRNA）、環狀RNA（circRNA）及長鏈非編碼RNA（lncRNA）在此領域展現出潛力。這些分子由稱為外泌體的小型細胞外囊泡攜帶，是細胞間通訊的關鍵角色，並與細胞增生、轉移及藥物抗性等重要癌症路徑之調控有關。本綜述討論外泌體ncRNA作為CRC創新生物標記及治療靶點之潛力。本研究涵蓋其在癌症生物學中的角色、應用上的挑戰，以及未來如何運用這些ncRNA推進CRC診斷與治療的方向。探索外泌體ncRNA為透過早期偵測與精準治療改善CRC管理開闢新途徑，可能為腫瘤病人照護帶來轉變。
